name.en: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>騎<rt>き</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt>し</rt></ruby>アイトワラス
name.zh-CN: 白鸦骑士 艾特瓦拉斯

text.en:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.
text.zh-CN:
幻想魔族协调＋协调以外的怪兽1只以上
此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：此卡特殊召唤的情况下，以自己及对手场上的各1张卡为对象可以发动。将该卡放回手牌。②：此卡被送至墓地的情况下，根据从何处被送至墓地，可以发动以下效果。
●场上：以场上的1张卡为对象可以发动。将该卡放回牌组。
●额外牌组：从自己墓地将1只“白鸦”怪兽特殊召唤。

materials: 1 Illusion-Type Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
